description: Messages disappear when opening a conversation, and friends list does not show on mobile devices. Make messages page fully responsive and stable for desktop and mobile.

problems_identified.title: Messages container scroll/jump issue
problems_identified.details: When opening a conversation, all messages animate upward and disappear. Likely caused by incorrect container height, overflow, or Framer Motion layout animation.

problems_identified.title: Friends list not visible on mobile
problems_identified.details: Friends list container is blank. Could be caused by responsive Tailwind classes (hidden / flex / width issues) or data not rendering properly on small screens.

expected_behavior: Messages appear in conversation view, correctly stacked from top to bottom or bottom to top scroll
Messages remain visible and animate smoothly without disappearing
Friends list shows all friends on mobile and desktop
UI is responsive on all screen sizes
Toast notifications for new messages still appear

requirements: Wrap messages in a scrollable container with proper height and overflow-y-auto
Use Framer Motion layout animation correctly with layoutId or variants
Ensure messages do not disappear when state updates
Auto-scroll to bottom when a new message is received

tasks.description: Fix friends list rendering on mobile
requirements: Check Tailwind responsive classes (sm:, md:, lg:) on the friends container
Ensure container width, height, and flex properties render correctly on mobile
Validate data is passed correctly to the list component
Wrap list items in shadcn/ui Card or List component for consistent layout
Add Framer Motion staggered animation for friend items
Test layout on mobile (portrait and landscape) and desktop
Use Tailwind responsive utilities to adjust flex/grid layout
Test conversation container height on small screens
Ensure toast notifications are not blocked by responsive layout
Log messages and friends array length on render
Log Framer Motion animation state for messages

steps: Open a conversation on desktop and mobile
Verify messages are visible, stable, and animate smoothly
Scroll to bottom should always show latest messages
Confirm all friends are visible and clickable
Test responsiveness across multiple devices and screen sizes
Check toast notifications for new messages appear correctly
